aliases.alias: Southside Data Centre, Land at Clawbare Cottage, Longformacus

summary: Proposed 225 MW data centre campus ('Southside') on moorland and farmland of the Roxburghe Estate at Clawbare Cottage, between Longformacus and Westruther in the Lammermuir Hills, about 11 km west of Duns. Promoted by Sunlaws Development Company Limited (SC121007), a Roxburghe Estates entity. Three two-storey buildings up to 24 m high with an 8.1 ha ground footprint are proposed, marketed as using curtailed local wind generation via the Fallago Rig substation, with a claimed £2bn investment and construction from about 2029 for 2030 operation. EIA screening (25/01835/SCR) concluded in February 2026 that EIA is required; a PAN and June 2026 consultations followed, and an EIA scoping report was submitted in July 2026. No full planning application has been lodged (expected no earlier than late 2026). A 'Save the Lammermuirs' campaign opposes the scheme.
maturity_explanation: Pre-application stage with formal early steps completed: EIA screening request submitted circa December 2025 (SBC ref 25/01835/SCR) with a screening decision reported 27 February 2026 that EIA is required; Proposal of Application Notice accepted by Scottish Borders Council in May/June 2026 with statutory consultation events held 4 and 10 June 2026; EIA scoping report submitted July 2026. No planning application validated — developer states one is expected no earlier than late 2026 — so M1, not M2.

latest_development.headline: EIA scoping report submitted to Scottish Borders Council; developer says full EIA and planning application expected no earlier than late 2026 (exact scoping submission date not confirmed; reported mid-July 2026)
